newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT-Bull Allen expected to sign with Manawatu.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT-Bull Allen expected to sign with Manawatu.

text.p: WELLINGTON, Nov 14 - Second division Manawatu are expected to announce the signing of All Black prop Mark Allen today, NZPA reports.
Allen's future has long been the subject of speculation and his move from his native Taranaki has been expected for sometime.
Allen confirmed yesterday he had made a decision on his playing future, but wouldn't say to which union he was moving.
"The people involved have an announcement planned and I'll be prepared to talk after that," he said.
Allen had been considered likely for sometime to move to Manawatu, to remain within the region of the Wellington Hurricanes who he captained last year.
